skill.name: api-documentation-generator
skill.description: Generate clear API documentation from code, including endpoints, parameters, examples, authentication, and error handling.

content.value_statement: API teams often lose time when endpoint behavior is unclear. This skill turns code and examples into structured, developer-friendly documentation.
actual_capabilities: Documents REST endpoints with methods, paths, parameters, headers, and response details.
Creates GraphQL query and mutation documentation from available schema or resolver context.
Adds authentication, authorization, pagination, filtering, and rate limit guidance.
Drafts request examples for cURL, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python clients.
Outlines OpenAPI or Swagger sections for endpoint reference pages.
Documents common error responses with status codes and troubleshooting notes.
limitations: It depends on source files, schemas, or examples that are available in the workspace.
It cannot verify live endpoint behavior unless the user provides test results.
Generated OpenAPI details still need review by an API owner.
It may miss runtime routes created outside visible code or configuration.

use_cases.title: Publish External API Reference
use_cases.description: Create public endpoint pages with authentication, examples, responses, and error guidance.

use_cases.title: Onboard Backend Engineers
use_cases.description: Turn service code into internal documentation for routes, models, permissions, and common workflows.

use_cases.title: Prepare OpenAPI Drafts
use_cases.description: Convert route and schema context into a reviewed outline for Swagger or OpenAPI documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Document One Endpoint
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single route.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to document this endpoint. Include purpose, parameters, authentication, responses, errors, and one request example.

prompt_templates.title: Document A REST Service
prompt_templates.scenario: Create documentation for a small API service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the REST API in this folder and create endpoint documentation grouped by resource. Include examples and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Create An OpenAPI Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the route handlers and models, then draft an OpenAPI-ready reference with schemas, auth notes, and response descriptions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit And Improve API Docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the existing API docs with the code. Identify missing endpoints, outdated examples, unclear parameters, and required fixes.

output_examples.input: A user route file with create, update, list, and delete handlers.
output_examples.output: A user resource reference with endpoint summaries, required fields, permissions, success responses, and common error cases.

output_examples.input: A GraphQL schema with user and post operations.
output_examples.output: A GraphQL documentation page with operation purpose, variables, response shape, authorization notes, and usage examples.

output_examples.input: Existing API docs and updated service code.
output_examples.output: A gap report listing stale examples, missing parameters, undocumented responses, and suggested documentation changes.

best_practices: Provide route files, schema definitions, and authentication rules for the most complete result.
Review generated examples against real tests before publishing external documentation.
Keep documentation close to code and update it with every API change.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated docs without reviewing security and permission details.
Do not use production secrets or real customer data in examples.
Do not rely on vague endpoint names when route behavior is available in code.

faq.question: Does this skill generate OpenAPI specifications?
faq.answer: It can draft OpenAPI-ready sections from visible routes and schemas. A human should validate the final specification.

faq.question: Can it document GraphQL APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can document queries, mutations, variables, response shapes, and errors when schema context is available.

faq.question: Does it call live API endpoints?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes and drafts documentation from provided code and context unless the user supplies test output.

faq.question: What files should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide route handlers, controllers, schemas, models, middleware, and any existing API documentation.

faq.question: Can it create examples for several languages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft examples for cURL, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and other requested clients.

faq.question: Is generated documentation ready to publish?
faq.answer: It is a strong draft. Review authentication, permissions, examples, and error behavior before publishing.
